shortBio.en: Van Halen vocalist from 1985; 5150-era keyed choruses and stadium radio.
shortBio.zh: 1985 年起 Van Halen 主唱；5150 时期有调性副歌与体育馆电台。

whyHub.en: Replacement singer with equal chart proof—Roth/Hagar camps never demobilize.
whyHub.zh: 有同等榜单证明的替换主唱——Roth/Hagar 两营永不复员。

body.en: Ex-Montrose. Joins after Roth; brings longer notes and harmony-friendly choruses. Multiple exits/returns. Rival lore with Roth is the public product as much as the records.
body.zh: 前 Montrose。Roth 之后加入；带来更长音与适合和声的副歌。多次离开/回归。与 Roth 的对打传说与唱片同为公共产品。
